title: Present perfect: for and since
text: The present perfect uses have/has + past participle. Use it for an action that started in the past and continues now, or a past action with a present result. For means a duration: for three years. Since means a starting point: since 2020. Example: She has worked in the sales department for three years. With an explicitly finished past time such as yesterday or last year, use the simple past: She submitted the report yesterday. For practice only; not official TOEIC test material.
